admission.justification: A detail that restates a rule drifts from the stage text it copies, so a Reviewer follows a superseded rule while the always-loaded stage says another.

applicability: The lifecycle baseline-review detail that a Reviewer reads before preparing a baseline review.
conditions: The review operation carries the rule itself, so the detail names and links it rather than copying its sentences.
exclusions: Other details and templates, which carry their own duties.

evidence: Baseline detail measures 268 words at its 268 limit and names the review-stage rule without restating it

statement: The baseline detail points to the review-stage rule instead of restating it.
